intro: A typical protein bar gives you about 200 kcal (estimate). The calories come roughly equally from protein and carbs, plus fat from nuts or chocolate coating.

breakdown.part: Fat from nuts and chocolate coating

diet: Yes, you can. A protein bar can be a practical snack when you're busy and have no other option. But it's still processed food, and some have the same calories as a regular chocolate bar. It has no special power to make you lose weight. Real food like eggs, chicken, fish and tauhu should still be your main protein sources.
tips: Read the label: pick one with at least 15 g protein and low sugar.
Keep it in your bag as an emergency snack, not an extra after every meal.
Have it with plain water and a fruit if you want to feel fuller.

swap.name: 2 boiled eggs + 1 apple
swap.why: Real food that's easy to carry, with good protein, fibre from the fruit, and usually cheaper.

faq.q: Can a protein bar replace lunch?
faq.a: Once in a while when you're desperate, okay. But it's too small to be a full meal, so you may get hungry again and eat more later.

faq.q: When is the best time to eat a protein bar?
faq.a: There's no must-time. Many people have it as an afternoon snack or after exercise when they can't get a proper meal.

faq.q: Why do some protein bars make me feel bloated?
faq.a: Some bars use sugar alcohol sweeteners or high fibre, which can make some people feel bloated. Try another type or have them less often if this happens.
